headline: Azerbaijan Expands Renewable Energy Capacity to 20 Percent of Power Output
summary: Renewable energy contributed 20% of Azerbaijan's total electricity production in the first nine months of the year as the country ramps up its capacity.
why: Azerbaijan is a major oil and gas producer transitioning part of its electricity generation toward renewables, which impacts its domestic energy mix and long-term export potential for fossil fuels.

impacts.name: Azerbaijan
impacts.why: Growth in domestic renewable energy generation shifts the energy mix of the country.
